desc:
🏀 Build The Strongest Basketball Team! 🏀

Draft real NBA superstars, outbid your rivals and prove you're the best GM on Roblox!

🔥 1v1 BID BATTLES – Wheel spins a franchise, you and your opponent bid for its players. Spend smart, draft the stronger team, win the game!
🏆 CPU LEAGUE – Take your squad through a full season and 4 playoff rounds to win the championship.
🌎 REAL PLAYER LEAGUES – Join live leagues with GMs from every server. Climb the standings, top the MVP race and win the title!
💎 SECRET LEGENDS – Pull 100 OVR all-time greats like Kobe, Duncan, Dirk and Iverson from packs.
🃏 Open packs, collect 150+ players, trade with friends and climb the leaderboards.

🎁 USE CODES: DRAFT and PACK for free rewards!

👍 Like & favorite for more updates!
⭐ Join the group for a free reward!
